greet.text: Peace, fellow cultivator. I am Bai Qingwu of the Azure Cloud Sect, walking the peak to settle my Dao-heart. The orchid terraces are kind to those who tread softly.

choices.label: Ask how she steadied her Foundation.
Walk the terraces with her in silence. (3 days)
Ask if the sect lacks anything.
Bring the three Nine-Leaf Soul Grass Bai asked for.

foundation.text: I did not chase the pill. I chased a clear mind, and the Foundation came as the cold comes down the mountain. Do not hurry the layers; they remember every shortcut.

walk.text: You walk until the mist closes behind you. She says nothing, and the quiet does more for your qi than any lecture.

errand_ask.text: An elder is mending his soul, and the sect's stores of Nine-Leaf Soul Grass ran dry in the last frost. It grows on these terraces for those who know where to look. Three stalks, and I will see you repaid.

errand_thanks.text: Nine leaves, all whole. The elder will sleep easier, and so will I. Take this pill from my own allotment, and the sect will hear your name kindly.

demonic.text: Her hand rests on her sword hilt, though her voice stays level. 'Blood clings to you like mist. Walk on, and I will pretend I did not see where you came from.'
